title: Warm Spicy Algerian Turkey Ham Tagine
description: This citrusy and pillowy dish features turkey ham in a rich and adventurous Algerian tagine, made with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, perfect for a cold evening, and is a hearty and flavorful meal that combines the warmth of spices with the comfort of slow-cooked meat.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced turkey ham and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth, lemon juice, and prunes, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro.
Deglaze the pan with a little water to get all the flavorful browned bits.
